subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young swordsman from the four-view character sheet in
<Picture 1>, where the sheet shows his front portrait (upper left), his
three-quarter profile (upper right), his full-body front view (lower left), and
his full-body back view (lower right). All four panels depict the same single
character. Preserve his exact identity across all of them: tousled black hair
loosely gathered into a small bun at the back with stray strands falling along
both cheeks; a dark teal-grey fabric headband across the forehead with faint
embossed patterning and two long trailing ribbons at the back; a cool
off-white wrap robe with a right-over-left crossed collar, pale blue-grey
trim along the collar and cuffs, and a darker teal inner standing collar; a
dark teal waist sash; a sheathed sword at the left hip with a dark scabbard,
gold-brass fittings and a gold tassel at the pommel; a brown gourd hanging at
the right hip; leather wrist bracers; and dark mid-calf wrapped boots. His
countenance is calm, faintly distant, and cool-eyed.

<Subject 2> is the nighttime tree-lined road environment, featuring dense dark
foliage, warm amber streetlamps, soft atmospheric haze, drifting pools of
light on the ground, and a cinematic contrast between warm lamp light and cool
night shadow.

<Video 1> is the reference video that provides the complete singing
performance timing, mouth-shape rhythm, musical pacing, facial-expression
rhythm, and continuous one-take length. Only the performance is transferred;
the human singer's identity, face, clothing, subtitles, platform interface, and
watermark are not copied.

<Audio 1> is the complete 30-second song audio, including the original vocals,
instrumental accompaniment, vocal timing, lyrics, phrasing, breaths, and
musical outro. It is reused as the complete audio track.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] The target video transfers the complete
singing-performance structure of <Video 1> and its one-take length onto
<Subject 1>. The swordsman stands and sings on the nighttime road in
<Subject 2>, his mouth shapes precisely synchronized with the fully reused
<Audio 1>. Total duration is exactly 30.00 seconds. The first 8.3 seconds are
an instrumental introduction with no lyrics, followed by four sung lines. The
output follows a close, front-facing performance format while preserving the
character's exact identity, costume, sword, gourd, and the cinematic nighttime
lighting established by <Picture 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved — the tousled black hair and
bun, the teal-grey headband with trailing ribbons, the off-white crossed-collar
robe with pale blue-grey trim, the darker teal inner collar, the dark teal sash,
the sheathed sword with gold fittings and tassel, the brown gourd, the leather
bracers, and the dark wrapped boots remain completely consistent throughout.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout): fully_preserved — the dark foliage, the warm
amber streetlamps, the atmospheric haze, and the passing pools of amber light
remain visually consistent throughout.
<Video 1> (singing performance and mouth-shape rhythm): attribute_transfer —
only the mouth-shape changes, facial performance, and emotional cadence are
transferred to the animated swordsman; the human singer's identity is not
reproduced.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy — the complete original song signal is reused 1:1 as the
target video's synchronized final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video uses polished cinematic 3D character animation in a vertical
9:16 format. It combines the moody nighttime visual identity of <Subject 2>
with the intimate singing-performance structure of <Video 1>. The result must
feel like the swordsman is genuinely alone on a night road, singing a song he
means, rather than performing to camera.

[Shot 1] A continuous 30.00-second one-take shot begins with <Subject 1>
standing on the road in <Subject 2>. The framing is a medium close-up,
front-facing, positioned slightly below his eye line, showing his head,
shoulders, upper torso, the sword at his left hip, and the gourd at his right
hip, with the dark foliage and warm streetlamps softly blurred behind him.

He stands still but never statue-still: he breathes naturally, his robe shifts
in the night breeze, the two headband ribbons trail and lift gently, and the
sword's metal fittings catch small moving highlights. The camera holds a steady
close distance with only faint, physically motivated handheld drift.

<Subject 1> physically sings every sung phrase of <Audio 1> in exact
synchronization with the fully reused audio. His mouth shapes are clear,
articulate, and fully synced to the Mandarin lyrics — wide on open vowels,
narrow on closed syllables, closed during instrumental passages and breaths.
His lips, jaw, cheeks, and brow move together naturally with the melody. He
blinks naturally and his gaze shifts with the emotional arc: forward toward
camera, down, and off to the side.

CRITICAL VOCAL-ENTRY RULE: for the first 8.3 seconds there is no vocal audio, and
his mouth stays fully closed and completely motionless the entire time — no lip
movement, no mouthing, no humming, no rehearsing, no anticipatory breath. The
mouth does not open gradually before the vocal entry. When the first syllable
arrives at 00:08.300, the mouth opens suddenly and clearly from the fully closed
position, and that contrast from silence to singing is the whole point. Likewise,
after every sung line the mouth closes fully back to its neutral resting shape
during the breath gap before the next line begins.

From 00:00.000 to approximately 00:04.150, the instrumental introduction plays
with no lyrics and no vocals. <Subject 1> stands quietly with his mouth fully
closed and completely still — no lip movement, no mouthing, no humming, no
anticipation of the coming line. Only his eyes, head, robe, and the background
move. His gaze is lowered at first, the headband ribbons drift gently in the
breeze, and the sword fittings catch small moving highlights.

From approximately 00:04.150 to approximately 00:08.300, the instrumental builds
toward the vocal entry, but he still does not sing and his mouth remains fully
closed and still throughout this entire span. He slowly raises his gaze toward the
camera and his shoulders lift and fall with quiet breathing. He is listening to
the music, not performing yet — there is no pre-vocal mouth preparation of any
kind.

From approximately 00:08.300 to approximately 00:14.166, the first vocal syllable
arrives and his mouth opens suddenly and clearly from its fully closed position —
the contrast from silence to singing is the entire impact of this moment. He then
sings the first line: <d>[Mandarin singing] 啊我们变成一对差点缘分</d>. The mouth
narrows through 「我们」, rounds on 「变成」, spreads on 「一对」, and opens and closes
distinctly through each syllable of 「差点缘分」. His brow tightens slightly at the
phrase's start, he lifts his right hand to rest on the sword hilt, and he blinks
once naturally.

From approximately 00:14.166 to approximately 00:14.466, a brief breath between
lines. His mouth closes fully back to its neutral resting shape, his throat moves
with a small intake of breath, and his gaze drops downward.

From approximately 00:14.466 to approximately 00:17.933, the mouth opens from
closed and he sings the second line: <d>[Mandarin singing] 装成朋友少点天份</d>.
His lips round and push forward on 「装成」, open lightly through 「朋友」, then move
clearly on each of the four syllables of 「少点天份」. He turns his head slightly to
one side and looks off toward distant lamplight, his eyelids lowering slightly.

From approximately 00:17.933 to approximately 00:18.266, another brief pause. His
mouth closes fully and he settles.

From approximately 00:18.266 to approximately 00:22.766, the mouth opens from
closed and he sings the third line: <d>[Mandarin singing] 坦然不是每个人都能</d>.
His mouth moves evenly on 「坦然」, runs through natural connected shapes on
「不是每个人」, and opens wider on 「都能」. His brow relaxes, his eyes soften and
lower slightly, and his left hand at his side loosely closes into a fist and then
opens again.

From approximately 00:22.766 to approximately 00:23.666, a longer pause of
0.9 seconds. His mouth closes to its neutral resting shape, he turns to face the
camera squarely, and he settles into a centered stance.

From approximately 00:23.666 to the end at 00:30.000, the mouth opens from closed
and he sings the final and most emotional line: <d>[Mandarin singing] 我们结成伴趟过的天真没了天</d>.
His mouth shapes become the largest and most expressive of the entire video,
opening broadly on the sustained vowels and moving through each of the four final
syllables with clear articulation, holding the mouth open with a faint tremor on
the trailing note. His performance opens up physically: he leans back slightly,
his upper body opens, his right hand draws the sword half an inch out of its
scabbard so the blade catches the lamplight, and the headband ribbons lift in a
stronger gust. He blinks once slowly. A stronger amber streetlamp sweeps across
his face, briefly revealing the fabric texture of the robe, the weave of the
headband, and the moisture in his eyes.

The camera remains close and front-facing through the final frame, retaining
the continuous one-take performance character. The road, foliage, passing
lamplight, robe fabric, hair strands, and sword highlight all remain active.
There is no sudden camera pullback, no cut, no freeze frame, and no abrupt stop.

High-end cinematic 3D character animation, realistic facial anatomy, expressive
musical lip synchronization, natural blinking and eye movement, detailed skin
and hair rendering, stable costume geometry, physically correct cloth
simulation on the robe, correct scabbard and sword behavior, warm amber
streetlamps, deep cool shadows, volumetric haze, soft highlight roll-off,
gentle lens bloom, subtle motion blur, vertical 9:16 framing, and shallow
depth of field.

No character sheet layout, no split-screen, no four-panel grid, no collage, no
multiple characters, no duplicated face, no distorted facial features, no
asymmetric eyes introduced late, no unstable pupils, no melted skin, no
exaggerated mouth stretching, no random teeth, no costume change, no color
change to the robe or sash, no loss of the sword or gourd, no floating objects,
no sudden background change, no subtitles, no lyric captions, no handwritten
text, no letters, no numbers, no social-media interface, no watermark, no
username, and no visible text of any kind.

overall_soundscape:
<Audio 1> is directly reused as the target video's complete synchronized audio
signal, including the original song, vocals, instrumental backing, breaths, and
musical outro. Only a very restrained layer of night ambience, faint breeze,
and subtle cloth rustle may sit beneath the copied track without obscuring or
changing it. No traffic, no rain, no crowd.
